title: 内门吱地拉开
summary: The inner door is drawn open from within with a dry long creak, and the old doorman stands inside — thin, bent, one hand still on the latch, head thrust forward.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) has just come through the gateway, 小罗 (S7) half a step behind her; they now face the second door — the narrow gatehouse room, bright and airy in the mid-morning, its ceiling light switched on and daylight pouring in through the open inner door; a half-table stands in the middle with a white-brass teapot, a coarse porcelain tea tray and a worn visitor's ledger.
[Shot 1] Medium from outside the doorway looking in: the inner door is pulled open from inside with a long dry creak of the hinge; 忠叔 (S18) stands in the doorway — about seventy, thin, bent, a dark grey buttoned jacket whose stand collar holds a thin neck, a ring of old bronze keys at his waist; one hand still rests on the inner latch and his upper body leans forward, his head thrust ahead out of habit.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.200, close: the door is only half open and a bar of daylight cuts in and lands on half his face; his old eyes are clouded and yellow, and at first they sit dully.
soundscape: A long dry hinge creak, the thin daylight leaking through the door crack, keys chiming faintly at his waist, and the courtyard's far air beyond the inner door.

title: 那双眼睛停了一下
summary: On the old man's eyes stopping on her face — not measuring, just stunned — his jaw working as if he has recognised something he dare not.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands inside the half-open inner door of the gatehouse, one hand on the latch, half his face in the daylight bar; 苏小满 (S1) stands just outside facing him; 小罗 (S7) stands at her rear.
[Shot 1] Close on 忠叔's (S18) eyes: they lift and, seeing the face outside, stop a beat — not studying her, but stunned; the small light in his pupils gathers for an instant like a stir in muddy water, then scatters; his jaw moves once, as if he has recognised something he dares not name; 小罗 (S7) sits half-hidden behind the door frame at his rear.
soundscape: The hinge's last creak settling, the thin daylight in the door crack, the visitor's ledger shifting on the half-table, and the courtyard air behind the inner door.

title: 目光落到那根红绳上
summary: His gaze travels down from her face to the collar of her coat, where a short worn red cord shows between the work-shirt lapels, mismatched with the house's new paint.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands in the doorway with his eyes fixed on 苏小满's (S1) face; she stands just outside facing him.
[Shot 1] Close, following his line of sight down through depth: his gaze slides from her face down past her jaw and her neck; 忠叔's (S18) old eyes are in the near plane at frame left and the collar at frame right, one slanted downward line pinning the two together.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, close on the collar: the plain coat's lapels are open a little, and between the navy work-shirt lapels a short length of an old red cord shows, its knot worn to a fuzz; its age does not match the house's fresh paint.
soundscape: The thin daylight in the door crack, the keys stirring at his waist, the ledger's pages lifting on the half-table, and the courtyard air in the far doorway.

title: 话又咽了回去
summary: Close on his face: the pupil gives a tiny contraction, the jaw moves again, and his throat bobs as he swallows the words back down.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands in the inner doorway of the gatehouse, his gaze having just dropped from her face to the cord at her collar.
[Shot 1] Close on his face: his pupil contracts very slightly; his jaw moves once more, as if about to speak, and then he swallows the words back; his throat bobs once on the swallow; the daylight bar holds still across his cheek.
soundscape: The thin daylight in the door crack, a swallow in his throat, the ledger shifting, and the courtyard air beyond the inner door.

title: 握门环的手顿住了
summary: Very close on his veined old hand where it has already settled on the bronze door ring and stopped, frozen half-gripped between effort and release, one tendon twitching.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands inside the doorway with his gaze dropped to the cord at the visitor's collar.
[Shot 1] Close on his hand: an old hand dense with liver spots, which was about to take hold of the bronze door ring inside the door and pull it wider.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, very close: the fingers have settled on the ring and stopped; the knuckles freeze on it, neither gripping nor letting go, and one tendon on the back of his hand twitches once; the bronze ring hangs motionless in that half-taken hold; the upper two thirds are the old hand and the ring, the bottom third the threshold and ground under the door frame.
soundscape: The bronze ring resting against the wood, the daylight bar in the door crack, the keys at his waist, and the courtyard air beyond.

title: 姑娘，请进
summary: His lips move twice before he gets the words out, dry and rough; he calls her young lady as if naming someone who should not be standing here.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands inside the doorway, his hand still frozen on the bronze ring; 苏小满 (S1) stands just outside facing him.
[Shot 1] Close on 忠叔 (S18): his lips move twice before he pushes the words out; his voice is dry, the way a man speaks who has not spoken for a long time, the tail of it rough; he calls her young lady very softly, less like a host's courtesy than like naming someone who should not be here at all: [Chinese] ……姑娘，请进。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, close: as he says it his eyes still cling to the cord; only after the words does he come back to himself for half a second and lift his gaze up to her face; the door ring is still not released.
soundscape: A dry cracked old voice, the bronze ring shifting a hair on the wood, the daylight bar in the door crack, and the courtyard air beyond.

title: 他侧身让路
summary: He turns sideways to open half the doorway and lifts a hand toward the yard, but his head does not follow and his gaze stays slanted on the cord.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands in the doorway with one hand on the door ring and his eyes on 苏小满's (S1) collar; she stands just outside.
[Shot 1] Medium from inside the doorway: 忠叔 (S18) turns his body sideways to open half the doorway and lifts one hand toward the yard in invitation; his back looks still more bent inside the door frame, and the little daylight in the doorway lights only one of his shoulders.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.800, close: but his head does not turn straight with his body — his face stays to the side and his gaze stays slanted, hung on the cord; by now she has stepped half a pace in and his eyes are still on the same spot; his wool-gathering is louder than his welcome.
soundscape: An old man's slow shuffle on the stone floor, his sleeve moving as he gestures, the keys at his waist, and the courtyard air through the doorway.

title: 忠叔，走什么神呢
summary: The steward comes round behind her, half inside the yard, laughs the moment off and asks the old man what he is wool-gathering about as he taps his briefcase.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands sideways in the inner doorway with his gaze still hung on the cord; 苏小满 (S1) has stepped half a pace in, facing him; the half-table with the teapot and ledger sits in the middle of the room.
[Shot 1] Medium over the shoulder: 小罗 (S7) has come round to 苏小满's (S1) rear, half his body already in the yard; he has seen something off about 忠叔 (S18), laughs once to smooth it over, and pats his briefcase as he speaks in a settled Mandarin: [Chinese] 忠叔，走什么神呢。人我带进去了。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, close on the steward's eyes: as he speaks his eyes flick back and forth once between 忠叔 (S18) and 苏小满 (S1) — a guest-steward's measure: nothing asked aloud, everything noted; the words pull 忠叔 back to himself.
soundscape: A light smoothing laugh, a briefcase patting twice, the keys at the old man's waist, and the courtyard air through the doorway.

title: 哎，哎
summary: As if shoved at the shoulder, the old man sways and answers twice, his hand finally dropping off the ring and shrinking away into his sleeve.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands in the inner doorway with his hand on the bronze ring, pulled back to himself by the steward's words.
[Shot 1] Close on 忠叔 (S18): as if someone had pushed him at the shoulder he sways, answering twice in a cracked voice: [Chinese] 哎，哎。 his hand at last loosens off the ring and drops; it gropes once over the half-table and then shrinks back into his sleeve.
soundscape: A cracked old voice answering twice, the bronze ring settling back against the wood, the teapot's faint breath on the half-table, and the courtyard air beyond.

title: 退进阴影里
summary: He eases the door wider, steps back into the deep corner of the gatehouse and lowers his head, yet even from there his eyes still follow half a beat after the direction she walks.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 忠叔 (S18) stands in the inner doorway with his hand just off the ring, having answered twice to the steward.
[Shot 1] Medium inside the gatehouse: 忠叔 (S18) pulls the door further open and steps back into the far corner of the room, head lowering; but even from there his eyes still follow half a beat after the direction she walks, and then he settles out of the framing, softly readable against the room's shaded far corner.
soundscape: The old man's slow steps withdrawing on stone, the teapot breathing on the half-table, the keys chiming once at his waist, and the courtyard air settling through the open door.
